rules.justification: anisotropic_damage, goldens of the UD-031 VARIANT of the oracle: oracle/patches/variants/ud031-anisotropic-damage-zero-init.patch (A_diag of tensorPlusOp zero-initialised, UD-031) and oracle/patches/variants/ud814-eig-noconvergence-zero-init.patch (zero eigenpairs after a non-converging EigenSolver in MatrixBase::eig, UD-814); D-003 A. The UD-031 patch alone did not remove every uninitialised read - in 3-D, once UD-763 makes D NaN, tensorSqrt(1 - D) read the uninitialised eigenpairs of a failed eigen-solve (valgrind: 686 reads in 3d_uniaxial). That read is masked in every recorded quantity (sqrt(1 - D) multiplies the never-written elastic stress, and each stress entry also subtracts a NaN term (1 - D):sigma_el/(dim - TrD)*(1 - D)_ij; only a NaN with a payload in the garbage would show; port-side test anisotropic_damage::tests::ud814_failed_eigensolve_is_masked_in_the_stress), and the UD-814 patch defines it; the variant build is valgrind-clean. With both defined every quantity of the reference code is deterministic, and the port's upstream mode (LawOptions::anisotropic_damage = Upstream: A_diag off-diagonals zero, a failed eigen-solve gives NaN, which the masking makes equivalent) replicates its operation order (Eigen-order fixed-size EigenSolver, eig_fixed / eig_vectors_fixed, glibc tan/atan2 ports): exact, sign-of-zero strict (D-051: the +-0 stress and energy are defined here), default quiet NaNs per D-046 (structured inventory in each manifest's notes). Covers damage, the broken-state tangent, the 3-D paths and the mazars-drucker-prager option instantiated through the C++ factory (probe --factory-option).
rules.evidence: 2026-11-11: generated on x86_64 (image 45122c21, strict, unpinned install with Eigen's cache sizes pinned in the probe, OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell, UD-031-only variant libakantu.so build-tree sha256 7566f5c2...), 3 identical runs in 3 container starts; 84/84 data files byte-identical on a compile-time pinned UD-031-only rebuild x 3 runs. (same image and unpinned install): the UD-031-only rebuild reproduces build-tree lib 7566f5c2... and valgrind counts (686 / 1,791); the UD-031 + UD-814 build (installed lib d55ce904..., install RUNPATH) is valgrind-clean on all 13 anisotropic cases (the 10 committed and three adversarial); the 7 goldens regenerated on it in 3 container starts: 84/84 data and input files byte-identical to the previous goldens in every run (manifests re-promoted: provenance, label, notes); the 71 regular x86_64 material cases staged on it are data-identical to their regular run (inertness). Measured: crates/akantu-solid/tests/material_fixtures_mat3.rs::anisotropic_damage_variant_ud031_bitwise, 5,540 / 5,540 values bit-identical (7 cases; 1,800 of them mazars-drucker-prager), aarch64 (D-046 canonical NaN) and the x86_64 gate.

rules.justification: anisotropic_damage, the three cases of the UNPATCHED oracle (upstream code, compat mode): the recorded quantities (stress and energy, which are +-0 because upstream reads the never-written elastic_stress; equivalent strain through Akantu's EigenSolver; elastic_stress and trace_damage (never written: +0); elastic tangent) do not depend on upstream's uninitialised A_diag entries (the damage internal does and is not recorded). Exact, sign-of-zero strict (D-051): the sign of the +-0 stress and energy/potential records follows the uninitialised damage in the oracle (UD-031), so a regeneration may flip it, but the replay reproduces the committed run's signs bit for bit (no D-051 exception is needed); their defined values are the variant goldens of the rule above; default NaNs match under D-046 (the cases' default NaNs are written 0x7ff8... by the aarch64 golden, 0xfff8... on x86_64). The elastic tangent of 2d_uniaxial does depend on the uninitialised A_diag entries, through the material-wide E/nu rewrite of the broken state (material_anisotropic_damage_tmpl.hh:229-238): three identical x86_64 oracle runs gave two variants. It is left out of the bitwise replay like the damage and compared only against this recorded run (which equals the zero-initialised variant: the three cases regenerated on the variant build give identical quantities); it is not migrated into the x86_64 corpus. The NaNs of 1d_uniaxial and 2d_uniaxial are documented in their manifest notes (D-046 (4)).
rules.evidence: Measured in crates/akantu-solid/tests/material_fixtures_mat3.rs, debug build: 920 / 920 compat values (3 cases) equal, all of them bit-identical. Since 2026-11-11, anisotropic_damage_material_points_match_oracle_where_defined counts identity with akantu_validation::exact_eq (Bitwise::Exact: sign-of-zero strict, D-046 NaNs; formerly by value), like the comparator's exact rule: 920 / 920 values bit-identical (damage excluded) on aarch64 macOS and in the x86_64 Linux image. An alternative fix (2026-11-11) had proposed to leave stress and energy/potential of these three cases out (680 values compared by value); the merge of 2026-11-12 kept the sign-strict comparison of every value but the damage (the larger compared set; the same exact rule), measured on the merged tree (aarch64, release): anisotropic_damage_material_points_match_oracle_where_defined 920 / 920 values exact, anisotropic_damage_equivalent_strain_and_tangent_bitwise 260 values bit-identical (2d_uniaxial tangent excluded), anisotropic_damage_variant_ud031_bitwise 5,540 values bit-identical.
